title: RMD & Withdrawal Sequencer
description: Given a set of retirement accounts, birth year, age attained, and a spending need, computes the required minimum distribution per account and in aggregate from the Uniform Lifetime Table, then sequences the remaining spending need across taxable, tax-deferred, and Roth money and computes the resulting federal tax and net spendable amount.
personas: adult child managing a parent's accounts
data_vintage: 2026 (Uniform Lifetime Table per T.D. 9930; SECURE 2.0 start ages; Rev. Proc. 2025-32 brackets)
